This coursebook is a self-contained study resource for the **Cryptography**
module, part of the Cybersecurity course unit of the Master's in Electrical
and Computer Engineering at the University of Trás-os-Montes e Alto Douro.

## Structure of the Coursebook {.unnumbered}

The chapters follow the structure of the module's lectures (the last two
lectures, TLS/PGP and algorithmic efficiency/PQC, are taught in the same
session):

1. Classical Cryptography — substitution, polyalphabetic and transposition ciphers
2. Block Ciphers — fundamentals, Feistel, DES and 3DES
3. AES — stages and modes of operation
4. Stream Ciphers — RC4, Salsa20, ChaCha20 and padding
5. Hashing — properties, attacks, SHA, MAC and HMAC
6. Asymmetric Cryptography and RSA
7. Diffie-Hellman and Digital Signatures
8. Elliptic Curve Cryptography
9. Public Key Infrastructure (PKI)
10. TLS and PGP
11. Algorithmic Efficiency and Post-Quantum Cryptography
